title: Learning about users and their needs
locator: Researching / Validating user needs; Linking user needs to user stories
short_quote: focus on the user’s problem rather than possible solutions
claim: Evidence-based needs describe a problem and outcome; implementation-specific user stories remain linked to needs. Research includes support staff and people who have difficulty with the current service.
limits: Official service-design guidance, not a controlled comparison. No prevalence threshold or automatic feature-removal rule is supplied.
